svg.aria-label: The search funnel: Fuse.js scores five fields with title weighted three, use_when two, category one and a half, and prompt and notes one each, then two exact filters narrow what is left.
svg.title: The search funnel
svg.desc: components/LibraryBrowser.tsx builds one Fuse index over all 372 templates with five weighted keys: title at 3, use_when at 2, category at 1.5, and prompt and notes at 1 each, with a threshold of 0.35 and ignoreLocation on. A query runs through that index first, and the category and framework filters are applied to the result afterwards.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A hit in a title is worth three in the body.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One Fuse index over five weighted fields, then two exact filters on whatever survives. All of it in the browser, with nothing to ask a server for.
